song.name: Auroria's Lament
song.plot: From the high plane of light, the Aurorians watch the storm gathering below — the darkness rising in the lower frequencies, their world dimming as the balance breaks. The Celestial Plane grieves as it foreshadows what Auroria will lose.
song.analysis: New song, written lore-first. POV: the Aurorians / Auroria itself (collective), the Celestial Plane grieving. Anchors: Auroria, the Celestial Gardens, the Crystal Sanctum (Anya's home), the Astral Archives, the three planes, the light dimming, the frequencies; references the scholars who study the sky (the Seers, who read planar frequencies with the Crystal Focus in the Seer's Library). Anya is NOT named or taken (the plucking is the next album beat). No Rift, no Vorgos, no war battles, no Nythoria character POV. Structure: Verse 1 → Chorus → Verse 2 → Chorus → Bridge → Chorus. Ethereal, slow. Suggested Suno direction: ethereal, sorrowful — high female choir, celesta/glass, slow strings, celestial pads.

section.name: Verse 1
section.reworked: From the Gardens where the starlight glows, We watch the lower skies turn grey. The scholars read the falling notes, And feel the light begin to fray.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: Auroria weeps for the distant dark, The frequencies are turning cold. The light we hold is growing faint, And we can feel the balance fold.

section.name: Verse 2
section.reworked: In the Sanctum of our quiet home, The crystal hums a warning song. The Celestial Gardens dim and moan, And every star begins to long.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: Auroria weeps for the distant dark, The frequencies are turning cold. The light we hold is growing faint, And we can feel the balance fold.

section.name: Bridge
section.reworked: What will the shadow take from us, When all the planes begin to bleed? We do not know the cost to come, Only the dimming of our creed.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: Auroria weeps for the distant dark, The frequencies are turning cold. The light we hold is growing faint, And we can feel the balance fold.
